Hi Priya —

Congrats again on the signed agreement. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (HLP_MAP_v1.2.xlsx) that embeds the post-signature implementation steps we discussed: staged rollout, canary execution, migration cutovers, and training windows. Key asks in this email: please confirm the proposed maintenance windows and a primary point of contact for IT access.

High-level timeline (proposed):
- Week 1 (canary): 2028-03-20 to 2028-03-26 — 10% of traffic routed to Redwood Dedicated variant; verification tests run nightly.
- Week 2 (scale): 2028-03-27 to 2028-04-02 — scale to 50% and validate latency/quality metrics.
- Week 3 (full cutover): 2028-04-03 — DNS cutover + rollback window; final runbook executed.

Proposed nightly maintenance window for canary migrations: 02:00 - 04:00 PT. If HelioPay prefers a different window, we can adjust.

Attachments included: HLP_MAP_v1.2.xlsx (MAP), canary-runbook.pdf (runbook + rollback steps), training-schedule.csv (initial training slots).

Next steps: please review the MAP and tell me by EOD Tue 2028-03-06 whether the dates/windows look good. Once we have your confirmation I will schedule the kickoff and loop in our SE/ops team for runbook rehearsals.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen

Stephanie —

Thanks for sending this over so quickly. A few quick clarifications from our side:

1) Maintenance window — the proposed 02:00-04:00 PT is acceptable, but can you confirm total downtime expected for full cutover? We need to inform our payments ops team.
2) Canary cohort size — we prefer a single-week canary but would like an option to extend if issues appear. Is automatic rollback supported or will we need to initiate manually?
3) SOC2 evidence — we requested the SOC2 artifact during procurement; the link you sent earlier isn’t working for me. Can you attach the SOC2 cover letter or share a direct download?

We’d like to lock dates by Tue 2028-03-06. Also, the attachments didn’t render in my email client — could you resend as a Drive link or upload to our shared DocuSign room?

Stephanie / team —

Looping in operations and account delivery notes. My suggested adjustments to present back to Priya:

- Maintenance / cutover: agree to 02:00–04:00 PT for canary migrations. For the full cutover we estimate a 20–30 minute traffic switch with up to 2 hours of verification (no expected transactional downtime if rollback executed within the window). We will document a soft-failure rollback path that re-routes to the pre-cutover endpoint.

- Canary control: start with 10% traffic for 7 days (automated monitoring). If error rate or latency delta exceeds thresholds in runbook (canary-runbook.pdf) we will auto-trigger a half-hour delay and alert ops; final rollback is manual-with-confirmation from HelioPay. We can extend the canary week-by-week if Priya requests.

- Training: propose two instructor-led sessions during Week 0 (pre-canary) — dates in training-schedule.csv. Recommend a dry-run with HelioPay ops two business days before canary.

Action items for Stephanie:
1) Resend MAP and artifacts as Drive links (SOC2 cover letter included).
2) Confirm final maintenance windows with Priya by Tue 2028-03-06.
3) Schedule dry-run: suggested 2028-03-17 02:00 PT.

I’m attaching a trimmed runbook and the training calendar for your send.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Priya / Anson —

Thanks for the quick review. Per internal ops guidance below, we will proceed with the proposed windows and controls unless you flag anything else. Summary of agreed items: 

Mutual Action Summary (quick):
- Canary week: 2028-03-20 -> 2028-03-26 (10% traffic; auto-monitoring + manual rollback capability)
- Dry-run: 2028-03-17 02:00 PT (Redwood SE + HelioPay ops)
- Scale week: 2028-03-27 -> 2028-04-02 (50% traffic)
- Full cutover: 2028-04-03 (DNS switch with 2-hr verification window)

Downtime expectation: traffic switch ~20–30 minutes; verification up to 2 hours. If rollback is required, we will re-route traffic back to the blue endpoint; rollback requires HelioPay confirmation via Slack / phone (we’ll include on-call numbers in the runbook).

SOC2: attaching direct link here: https://drive.redwood.com/link/SOC2-HelioPay-Artifact (includes cover letter and scope). Also uploaded all MAP artifacts into your DocuSign room: https://app.docusign.com/rooms/HLPay-activation-2028

Attachments now included as Drive links and a condensed MAP (HLP_MAP_v1.2.xlsx). Please reply with a single-line confirmation that you approve these dates and we’ll lock the kickoff. If we don’t hear back by EOD Tue 2028-03-06 we’ll assume approval and proceed to schedule kickoff resources.

Cheers,
